scripts.build: bun run --filter @assemble/desktop build && bun run sign:mac
scripts.build:frontend: bun run --filter @assemble/desktop build:frontend && bun run admin:build && bun run media:build && bun run browser:build
scripts.mcp: ASSEMBLE_SERVER_ORIGIN=https://as.yxswy.com cargo build --release -p assemble-mcp && bun run sign:mac
scripts.typecheck: bun run --filter @assemble/desktop typecheck && bun run --filter @assemble/admin typecheck && bun run --filter @assemble/media-web typecheck && bun run --filter @assemble/media typecheck && bun run --filter @assemble/ui typecheck && bun run --filter @assemble/display typecheck && bun run --filter @assemble/browser-extension typecheck && bun run typecheck:tools
scripts.rust:clippy:windows: cargo clippy -p assemble-protocol -p assemble-transfer -p assemble-store -p assemble-device -p assemble-schedule --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.browser:host: cargo build -p assemble-desktop --bin assemble-browser-host --release && bun run sign:mac
